system_requirements.name: Verified production identity and tenant context
system_requirements.requirement: Every command must receive a server-verified actor_id, tenant_id, tenant membership, and action permission from the approved identity provider. Public requester access must use a scoped verified request capability and must not expose staff permissions.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Keep provider credentials server-side and outside product records. Persist only non-secret provider subject references when policy permits.

fail_closed.result: roll back the full command and emit no success response

system_requirements.name: Durable tenant-scoped transactional persistence
system_requirements.requirement: Persist canonical records, optimistic revisions, idempotency results, audit entries, and outbox events in a durable database with tenant_id on every key and restrictive foreign keys.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Do not persist database credentials or raw connection secrets in architecture or business records.

fail_closed.result: reject mutation or return the exact recorded result; never execute twice
when: the same key has a different request digest

system_requirements.name: Atomic command idempotency ledger
system_requirements.requirement: Reserve tenant_id, command_id, and idempotency_key atomically with a request digest, then retain the recorded result and event_id for safe retries.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Store request digests and non-secret correlation values, not raw tokens or provider secrets.

when: the event cannot be written atomically
a required entity or state reference is absent

system_requirements.name: Transactional audit and event delivery
system_requirements.requirement: Write each domain event with tenant_id, event_id, command_id, idempotency_key, actor_id, entity refs, prior state, next state, policy refs, and occurred_at in the same transaction as state. Deliver from an at-least-once outbox with consumer idempotency.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Events may carry stable refs and approved audit facts but no raw secrets or unrestricted evidence payloads.

fail_closed.result: reject the evidence command and do not mark evidence usable

system_requirements.name: Authorized evidence object storage
system_requirements.requirement: Store evidence objects outside canonical JSON records through immutable object refs, tenant-scoped authorization, integrity hashes, content scanning, and short-lived access grants. The request_evidence entity retains metadata and version lineage.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Never persist raw storage credentials or long-lived signed URLs. Keep restricted evidence out of events and notification bodies.

fail_closed.result: block the transition and open or update an attributable authority exception
when: a required policy version is missing
an SLA target cannot be derived for an action that requires one

system_requirements.name: Versioned operating rules and SLA targets
system_requirements.requirement: Resolve qualification, assignment, evidence, readiness, escalation, retention, and service-level targets from an owner-manager-approved policy version. Record the applied policy ref and any computed target_at with each decision. This architecture defines no default response-time promise.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Policies contain rules and references only, not identity-provider, notification-provider, or database secrets.

fail_closed.result: do not send; retain a pending or failed notification obligation without rolling back committed business state
when: recipient consent or authority is absent
channel classification does not permit the payload

system_requirements.name: Approved post-commit notifications
system_requirements.requirement: Send only policy-permitted requester, assignee, escalation, and recipient notices after commit through an approved channel. Retain delivery attempts without treating delivery as a workflow decision.
system_requirements.secret_policy: Keep channel credentials server-side. Notification payloads must exclude staff-only risk notes, unrestricted evidence, and raw secrets.
